title: Tight jams: fights and running from trouble at dances
summary: Stories of a thrown cue ball, a beer bottle hitting Chester Zeno, and Melvin Frank and Joe Moyes running from shooting at a dance near Claiborne.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
